findings.title: Collides with Al Noor Hospitality Group: GCC hospitality data analytics non-compete
findings.impact: Collides with the Al Noor promise, live until September 2029.

citations.quote: The Service Provider shall design, develop, test, deploy and support a revenue management and guest analytics platform for the Company's nine (9) Properties located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as listed in Schedule 2

Revenue Management Module** — demand forecasting at room-type and night level, dynamic rate recommendations, competitor rate ingestion, pickup and pace analysis, and a length-of-stay and overbooking optimisation engine

Guest Analytics Module** — a unified guest profile consolidating data from the Company's property management system, central reservation system, loyalty programme and point-of-sale systems; guest segmentation; lifetime value scoring; and propensity models for upsell and repeat stay
it is not bound by any agreement or restriction which would prevent or restrict it from performing the Services for the Company

In consideration of the Client disclosing to the Supplier its Confidential Information, including its revenue strategies, pricing models and Guest Data, the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC

Hospitality Business**" means any person, firm or entity that owns, operates, manages or franchises hotels, resorts or serviced apartments, or that provides distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to any such person, firm or entity
Restricted Period**" means the Term and the period of eighteen (18) months following the expiry or termination of this Agreement

GCC**" means the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council, being the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the State of Qatar, the State of Kuwait, the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman

findings.counterPosition: Seek a written waiver or consent from Al Noor Hospitality Group, or defer the engagement until after the restriction period ends in September 2029. The business team and legal counsel should decide on the appropriate strategy.

waiver.covers: AtliQ providing demand-forecasting services to Seaside Hotels LLC, Muscat, Oman, solely as described in the statement of work between the Supplier and Seaside dated February 2026
waiver.why: The Al Noor waiver is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW for Seaside Hotels LLC in Oman and explicitly does not extend to other GCC hospitality businesses.
